description: An Autonomous march on the federal courthouse in downtown Denver was organized by local anarchist late Tuesday afternoon. Several affinity groups rallied outside the south side of the court house and marched on the front of the building shortly after dusk. After fireworks were set off riot police moved in to protect the federal courthouse. Opting out of a useless stand off and eventual police aggression, the Bloc instead moved away from the court house towards the 16th Street Mall. Once reaching the mall the Bloc began to smash out the windows of several corporate owned businesses including; Starbucks, Target, McDonalds, Corner Bakery & US Bank.

faqs.answer: On July 28, 2020, approximately 65 masked protesters in black clothing gathered for an autonomous march on the federal courthouse in Denver. After police moved in with riot gear, the group dispersed and marched to the 16th Street Mall where windows of corporate businesses were broken, including Starbucks, Target, McDonalds, US Bank, and others.
faqs.question: What was the Black Bloc action on 16th Street Mall?

faqs.answer: After police confronted the group at the federal courthouse, protesters chose to target corporate businesses on the 16th Street Mall instead of engaging in a direct confrontation that could result in mass arrests. The action was a form of property destruction directed at symbols of corporate power. It was the nearest high value target to send a clear message as 16th street was only 2 blocks away, and the mall began in another 2 blocks.
faqs.question: Why did the protest target the 16th Street Mall?

faqs.answer: The July 2020 protests were part of ongoing nationwide demonstrations demanding justice for Elijah McClain, a 23-year-old Black man killed by Aurora police in 2019, and broader Black Lives Matter protests against police brutality. Initially a protest was called outside the federal courthouse in Denver, but protesters were met with a large force of riot cops. The choice was then made to attack capitalist power structures along the outdoor mall.
faqs.question: What was the context for this Denver protest?

faqs.answer:
Police in riot gear were pre-staged before the protest even began. When protesters set off fireworks at the federal courthouse, approximately 4 dozen riot police converged on the area. Once leaving the courthouse polcie assumed the protest had fully disperesed.
Later, police conducted a snatch-and-grab arrest of a protester leaving after the action near the State Capitol.
